## **Appendix B - Automotive Specification at 1.8V** 

### **DATASHEET** 

This document contains information specific to devices operating at voltage between 1.8V and 3.6V. Only deviations with standard operating characteristics are covered in this appendix, all other information can be found in the complete Automotive datasheet. The complete ATtiny25/ATtiny45/ATtiny85 automotive datasheet can be found on http://www.atmel.com 

7669E-AVR-04/14
